title: Shortcuts and OneLake security
objectives: Say what a shortcut is and why it copies nothing
Explain where access to shortcut data is decided
Filter rows by who is asking, the way a row-level security rule does

exercises.prompt: A row-level security rule shows each person only the regions they are mapped to in user_regions. Return the rows of sales that ana@contoso.com may see: region and amount, in region then amount order.
hints: Keep a sale only when user_regions has a row for ana@contoso.com with that sale's region.
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_regions AS u WHERE u.user_name = 'ana@contoso.com' AND u.region = s.region)
